RTO700 Real Tube Overdrive by Maxon | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Maxon RTO700 Real Tube Overdrive LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS Description The RTO is an amazingly amp-like overdrive. While many companies claim to offer “amp in a box” pedals, the RTO is in actuality a tube preamp circuit in a stand-alone stompbox format. The RTO700 has all the tone and responsiveness of the best boutique tube amps. From bluesy overdrives to the elusive “Brown Sound” and beyond, all can be easily achieved with any amp at any volume when using the RTO.
